PSED · knowledge base

Recipe store

Every experiment lifted into an actionable Recipe — the object the LLM agent and the MPC twin both consume. Missing values are inferred probabilistically from the most similar experiments (covariate-conditioned), not a global median — each carries a credible interval and cites its donors.

Read completeness with care. “Filled completeness” counts KB-imputed and model-default fields alongside measured ones, so it is not a measure of recipe readiness — read it together with fields directly extracted. A non-degenerate temperature_window_C is an admissible range, not a scalar condition, and is never counted as a completed recipe field. Scalar temperatures previously produced by collapsing such a range to its lower endpoint have been removed, so any drop in filled completeness here is a truthfulness correction, not a model regression.
paper stated for the whole paper (methods/table) · experiment read from this experiment’s caption or series · derived deterministic transformation · kb inferred from the most similar experiments (hover: value, 68% CI, donor experiments) · model filled from a twin default — hover any badge for its exact origin
